title: Chapter 1454
text:
Originally, he wanted to go back to sleep, but he had no choice but to obediently get up and write. He would try to write more in the next few days.

Finally, thank you for your support!

…

PS: By the way, I saw a brother asking me when I would finish writing. I will definitely finish before the end of the year. According to my estimation, I will finish writing around this month.

"Godly Mechanic Super" is shocked. Thank you to the Golden Alliance, Sun and Moon in a Pot, Universe in a Sleeve.
